rows.query: What is the return window for apparel?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Apparel and Footwear can be returned within 15 days if they are unworn, unwashed and have all tags attached. Home products have a 10-day return window, and Electronics have a 7-day window with original packaging and all accessories included. An item is eligible if it is inside its category return window and is not on the non-returnable list, which includes opened Beauty products, innerwear and gift cards.

rows.query: How long does a refund take for a Cash on Delivery order?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Prepaid cancellations are refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Cancelling a Cash on Delivery order needs no refund because no money has been collected. Once the returned item passes the quality check at the warehouse, the refund is started within 2 business days and reaches the bank account in 3 to 5 business days.

rows.query: How many days does standard delivery take in metro cities?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Standard delivery in metro cities takes 2 to 4 business days from the date the order is shipped. Non-metro and remote pin codes take 5 to 8 business days. Express delivery, where available, promises delivery within 24 to 48 hours for an extra fee.

rows.query: How does reverse pickup work and how many pickup attempts does the courier make?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Reverse pickup is available for eligible returns at most serviceable pin codes. The courier makes up to 2 pickup attempts within 3 business days of the return being approved. If the pin code is not serviceable for pickup, the customer can drop the parcel at the nearest partner courier outlet and Nykaa reimburses the shipping cost.

rows.query: What warranty do hair dryers come with?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Warranty applies mainly to Electronics and select Home appliances, and it covers manufacturing defects only. Electronics such as trimmers, straighteners and hair dryers carry a 12-month brand warranty from the date of delivery. Home appliances carry a 6-month warranty.

rows.query: Can I cancel my order after it has shipped?
rows.answer: According to our policy: An order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, so orders in Placed status can be cancelled instantly from the My Orders page. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled, and the customer should refuse delivery or request a return after receiving it. Prepaid cancellations are refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

rows.query: How many loyalty points do I earn and what is each point worth?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Customers earn 1 loyalty point for every 100 rupees spent on an order, and the points are credited 7 days after delivery. Each point is worth 0.5 rupees at redemption, and points can cover up to 20 percent of the order value, with a minimum redemption of 200 points. Points expire 12 months after they are earned.

rows.query: My payment failed but the money was debited, what happens?
rows.answer: According to our policy: If a payment fails the order is not placed, and any amount already debited by the bank is reversed automatically within 5 to 7 business days. The customer can retry the payment up to 3 times, using the same or a different method, within 30 minutes, after which the cart is released. For UPI and card failures the customer should first check whether the bank has already debited the amount before retrying.

rows.query: Can I exchange my shoes for a different size?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Size exchanges are available for Apparel and Footwear within 15 days of delivery, subject to stock in the requested size. Only one size exchange is allowed per order item, and the replacement is delivered free of cost once the pickup is complete. If the requested size is out of stock, the customer can choose a refund instead.

rows.query: My item arrived damaged, how do I report it?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Damaged, defective or wrong items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery through the Help section of the app. Claims reported after 48 hours are reviewed case by case and may be rejected. International orders cannot be returned or exchanged, although a damaged item can still be claimed within 48 hours.

rows.query: Can I send a perfume or an aerosol to another country with international shipping?
rows.answer: According to our policy: International shipping is offered only to a limited set of countries and only for non-restricted products. Aerosols, flammable perfumes, batteries and large-volume liquids cannot be shipped abroad because of airline safety rules. International orders cannot be paid for with Cash on Delivery, and the customer is responsible for any import duties and taxes charged at the destination.

rows.query: Who handles my complaint if it is still unresolved after 72 hours?
rows.answer: According to our policy: Level 2 is the senior support team, which handles delayed shipments, refund disputes and damaged-item claims that remain unresolved after 24 hours. Level 3 is the Support Manager, who handles cases unresolved after 72 hours, payment disputes above 5,000 rupees and any legal or consumer-forum complaint. International orders cannot be returned or exchanged, although a damaged item can still be claimed within 48 hours.
